title: Transpose equality for the etale coordinate Kunneth routes
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, a proper morphism f:X→Y, and objects L and M as in the coordinate Kunneth factorization, the pullback along f of each of the two displayed route morphisms, followed by the counit of pull f ⊣ push f, is equal.

source.place: First triangle, the coordinate interchange calculation before cancellation by the derived adjunction.

proof.text: Expand both projection maps by their adjunction-mate formulas. Naturality of the derived tensor comparison moves pullback through the tensor, while the mate equations for exchange1 and exchange2 identify the two base-change routes. The tensor comparison for the pullback square identifies the resulting maps, and the counit equation for directComparison identifies their direct-image targets.
